performance.required: Area-weighted U-value 1.6 W/m2K maximum to windows, doors and screens, with documentary evidence of the energy efficiency rating (spec 2.28, 2.33.5, 2.38.3). PSDS4 decarbonisation scheme - the U-value is the purpose of the job.
performance.evidence: None held. Mercury QL004741 states no U-value at all and quotes 'Clear Lam Tgh' with no low-E or soft coat named. Bellview 0000000513 states Ug 1.0 and Ug 1.1, which is centre-pane glass, not a whole-element area-weighted Uw. BSW QT253508 states EcoPlus 1.0, again glass only. No supplier has certified an element Uw and the issued proposal makes no compliance statement.
